description:
'''Noah James Shebib''' (born March 31, 1983), better known by his stage name '''40''', is a Canadian record producer, songwriter, record executive, and former child actor from [[Toronto]], Ontario. He is best known for his production work with fellow Toronto native [[Drake (musician)|Drake]], having extensive involvement in the entirety of [[Drake singles discography|Drake's discography]] since 2008. Shebib's production style, often described as [[downtempo]] and ambient, has become synonymous with Drake's sound. His other production credits include [[Lil Wayne]], [[Alicia Keys]], [[Beyoncé]], [[Action Bronson]], and [[Jamie Foxx]].

Shebib and Drake are two of the three co-founders of the [[OVO Sound]] label, which was launched as an imprint of [[Warner Records]] in 2012. Shebib has won two [[Grammy Award]]s from 20 nominations.
